title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
abstract: arXiv:2609.22068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training capable coding agents via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse tasks with reliable verifiers. Open-source codebases offer a rich source of such tasks, while existing methods typically rely on development artifacts such as issues and commits, limiting the range of tasks that can be extracted. To better scale RL environments, we present CodeMidas, an agentic pipeline that turns implemented functionality in existing codebases into executable RL environments using source code as its only task-specific input. CodeMidas allocates agentic compute to every stage of environment construction: agents explore implemented functionality to formulate behavioral specifications, construct tests grounded in execution of the original code, and validate and filter candidate tasks through execution checks and repeated solution rollouts. translated_title: CodeMidas：从代码本身扩展智能体编程强化学习环境
translated_abstract: 通过强化学习（RL）训练强大的编程智能体需要多样化的任务和可靠的验证器。开源代码库为此类任务提供了丰富的来源，但现有方法通常依赖于问题报告和提交记录等开发产物，这限制了可提取任务的范围。为了更好地扩展强化学习环境，我们提出了CodeMidas，这是一个智能体化的流水线，它仅以源代码作为任务特定的输入，将现有代码库中已实现的功能转化为可执行的强化学习环境。CodeMidas在环境构建的每个阶段都投入智能体计算资源：智能体探索已实现的功能以制定行为规范，基于原始代码的执行构建测试，并通过执行检查和重复的解决方案推演来验证和筛选候选任务。由此产生的数据集包含来自3,185个开源代码库、涵盖23种编程语言的5,545个训练任务。
tldr: CodeMidas提出了一种仅以源代码为输入的智能体化流水线，能够自动将开源代码库中已实现的功能转化为可执行的强化学习训练环境，构建了包含5,545个任务、覆盖23种编程语言的大规模数据集。
en_tdlr: CodeMidas is an agentic pipeline that uses only source code as input to automatically convert implemented functionality in open-source codebases into executable RL environments, yielding a large-scale dataset of 5,545 tasks spanning 23 programming languages.
